\section{Content-addressed artifact ledger}\label{fin:app:ledger}

compressed files.  Their byte counts refer to those same compressed files and
therefore permit a check before decompression.  Digests explicitly introduced
as uncompressed identities or as metadata-record identities have the separate
meaning stated in their surrounding text.
